session_summary: As a first-time player, I successfully completed the Moss Trail route. I walked forward through 12 steps, encountering and defeating three enemies (Goblin, Slime, and Kobold), ending with 100 HP and 149 coins total.

observations.evidence: Play trace begins immediately with walk actions on Moss Trail without any introductory tooltips or guidance at step 0.
observations.recommendation: Introduce welcome tooltips or an introductory prompt at step 0 to guide first-time players on initial movement and combat basics.

observations.evidence: Successfully finished Moss Trail and received Moss Trail completion reward (+25 coins).
observations.recommendation: Keep the Moss Trail difficulty 1 route as a welcoming entry point for fresh players.

feature_requests.title: Onboarding Welcome Tooltips
feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players understand controls and objectives instantly without guessing.
feature_requests.rationale: Currently, a new player drops straight into a route with zero guidance.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Display clear introductory text prompts at the start of the first session explaining how to move and fight.

keep: Smooth difficulty 1 introduction via Moss Trail
Clear feedback on route completion and coin rewards
focus: onboarding, clarity, route choice, controls, first-session friction
